scope: Existing data/photos.json reference photographs with no explicit productIds. PARS ALPHA and COBRA II work is excluded. Inventory-level triage is not a fresh audit of all images.

plan.goal: Identify individually verified product-reference mappings for at most five products while preserving current-event photo priority.
plan.impact: Follow-up research queue only; no operating data, code, images, IDs, statuses or commits changed.
risks: equipmentId mistaken for verified product identity
Source filename mistaken for depicted variant
Existing files counted as new image acquisitions
verification: Read project state and source registry

definitions.readyReference: Matches the existing general/named product at the stated source granularity; never verifies current-event configuration.
definitions.qualifiedPrototype: Source labels the pictured prototype, but exact subtype is not established by a readable model plate. Use only the qualified caption and date limitations.
definitions.rejected: Usage rights may be valid, but the depicted model differs from or does not prove the target product.
definitions.inventoryOnly: Triage uses existing notes only; no fresh rights/pixel completion claim.
